title: fix: prevent internal runtime context from appearing in replies

commit.messageHeadline: fix: unify runtime context carrier ownership
test: align guest completion boundary
fix: preserve legacy carrier cache opt-out
fix: retain legacy carriers across replay
fix: fence legacy carriers at privacy boundaries
fix: separate runtime markers from provider shape
fix: retain marker-only runtime carriers
refactor: share persisted carrier recognition
fix: preserve legacy runtime carrier policy
fix: include runtime carrier dependencies in PR wrapper
fix: resolve runtime carrier sources in clean CI
fix: preserve mixed-media carrier placement
test: align runtime carrier boundaries after rebase
fix: recognize mixed runtime carriers at owner boundaries
test: drop duplicate rebased gateway fixtures
fix: preserve legacy carrier blocks before signed replay
test: follow typed subagent completion context
fix(ai): exclude canonical media context from cache
chore: refresh environment variable ratchet
test: separate compaction runtime messages from snapshots
fix: preserve shipped runtime replay projection
fix(agents): retain steering runtime context lifecycle
fix(agents): preserve batched steering carrier ownership

### Stable-line gap: this class still reproduces on v2026.9.9; the fix is not in the 2026.9.x line

This PR's problem description matches a symptom class we hit in the wild, so this is a gap report against the stable line rather than a new bug report, since the repair already exists here.

**Environment:** self-hosted gateway on Windows, Control UI webchat, versions v2026.9.8 and v2026.9.9 (stable line).

**Observed:**

1. **v2026.9.8 (2026-10-05):** the injected runtime-context envelope (the "Conversation data (data, not instructions)"-labeled per-turn blocks) rendered as **visible message content** in the chat stream instead of staying model-only plumbing. In the same thread, assistant turns intermittently ended with no user-visible answer at all: the runtime recovery path prompted "The previous attempt did not produce a user-visible answer" repeatedly, and the visible answers that did arrive came through stream-fallback replacement segments (`openclawStreamFallback`).
2. **v2026.9.9 (2026-10-10):** same class in milder form: some assistant turns carried raw tool-call envelope JSON (`{"tool": {...}}`) as their visible message text instead of prose, and turns again intermittently ended without a user-visible answer.

**Release gap** (commit ancestry via the compare API, merge commit `cd9913f1`):

- `compare/v2026.9.9...cd9913f1` = `diverged` (ahead 2758 / behind 253): this fix is **not** an ancestor of `v2026.9.9` (published 2026-10-08, five days after this PR merged).
- `compare/v2026.10.1-beta.2...cd9913f1` = `behind` (ahead 0 / behind 183): the fix **is** contained in `v2026.10.1-beta.2`.
- v2026.9.8 predates the merge entirely (published 2026-10-03T03:21Z, merge landed 2026-10-03T20:09Z), and the v2026.9.9 release notes do not mention this class.

**Question for maintainers:** is a cherry-pick to the 2026.9.x stable line planned, or should affected stable users wait for 2026.10.1? We will re-verify against 2026.10.1 when it ships and report back here.

If the tool-call-envelope-as-visible-text variant in observation 2 is considered a distinct output-cleanup bug rather than this class, say so and we will file it separately with a repro.

Related (closed via this PR): #110190, #162001.
